# Third-party damage calculator

Included files `data.min.js` and `calc.min.js` are the browser distributions of **@smogon/calc version 0.12.0**, supplied by the user as `calc-0.12.0.tgz`. The package identifies its license as **MIT**.

Source: https://github.com/smogon/damage-calc
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@smogon/calc

These bundles are bundled locally, not loaded remotely at runtime. No additional npm installation is necessary for browser users.
The upstream MIT license text is included in `LICENSE`.
